name: seat-resume
description: Keeps a registry of interactive sessions so /resume-sessions can list and reopen the ones a crash, reboot or closed terminal interrupted (Windows, PowerShell, WezTerm or Windows Terminal)

registry_dir.title: Registry folder
registry_dir.description: Where the plugin writes one small JSON file per interactive session. Leave empty for session-registry inside your Claude config folder (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else the .claude folder in your home folder).

sessions_dir.title: Claude Code sessions folder
sessions_dir.description: The folder where Claude Code itself records each running session (one <pid>.json per session). Leave empty for sessions inside your Claude config folder.

resume_script.title: Resume script
resume_script.description: Path to the PowerShell script that lists and reopens sessions. Leave empty to use the one bundled with the plugin.

powershell.title: PowerShell program
powershell.description: The program that runs the resume script: pwsh (PowerShell 7) or powershell (Windows PowerShell 5.1).

terminal.title: Terminal for reopening
terminal.description: The terminal the script's -Launch option opens each session in, one tab per session.
